misc.title: Misc
misc.hideDeletedHelp: Whether to show deleted articles in the article download table. When enabled, the table filters out deleted articles regardless of whether their content has been downloaded.
misc.forceDownloadHelp: When fetching article content, already downloaded content is skipped. When enabled, cached content is ignored and the latest content is downloaded again.
misc.metadataOverride: Overwrite article content when fetching reads
misc.metadataOverrideHelp: When fetching reads, article content is downloaded as well. When enabled, the content will also be saved to the cache and use additional storage.
misc.syncFrequencyHelp: When syncing account article data, the app keeps fetching all articles until the sync is complete. This option controls the fetch interval. For example, 5 means fetching once every five seconds. Smaller values sync faster but can increase account risk. At least 3 is recommended.
misc.syncDateRangeHint: (Note: syncing can only go backward from the current time)

api.summary1: To help third-party developers customize their integrations, this site exposes its main features, including account search, historical article list queries, article downloads, and more, through APIs.
api.notice: Note: API access is currently free. It may be adjusted later based on actual usage and may become paid.
api.privateDeployHint: If you have a large request volume, private deployment is recommended.
api.authKeyIntro: Unless otherwise stated, all APIs below require an auth key. The key can be sent in either of these ways:
api.authHeader: a. Through the custom request header X-Auth-Key
api.authCookie: b. Through a Cookie named auth-key
api.authIntegrated: The API auth key is integrated with this site's login. After scanning to log in on the site, the API key will be refreshed automatically.
api.authExpires: Because the key shares the same auth system as the website, it expires when the website login expires.
api.queryAuthKey: Query API auth key (make sure your current login is valid)
